## Scientific And Domain Assessments

### Retained structure and identifier correspondence

identity: supported. Targets: CHEBI:6570.

CHEBI:6570 and complete key MQYXUWHLBZFQQO-QGTGJCAVSA-N join the retained MIBiG BGC0001317 version 3 and 3-star ChEBI lupeol concepts. The ChEBI definition describes a lupane triterpenoid bearing a 3β hydroxyl and broad occurrence contexts; those definition claims remain attributed. PubChem 259846 was not freshly resolved. Exact local full-key agreement supports retained grounding, while the isolated natural stereochemical identity remains dependent on historical sources.

### Representation

representation: supported. Targets: CHEBI:6570.

Both saved forms are neutral C30H50O, with 31 heavy atoms, 35 bonds and one connected component. The complete tables retain five carbocyclic rings, one terminal exomethylene and one alcohol; no carbonyl, ether bridge or candidate C5O ring is present. All ten potential tetrahedral centres are specified, including the hydroxyl-bearing carbon; the terminal exomethylene does not require E/Z assignment. Both canonical SMILES and all other original comparison flags agree. The original chirality-aware correspondence spans all 31 atoms but explicitly does not establish independent full-graph or natural identity. The ChEBI 3β wording is a source assignment, not a new stereochemical experiment.

### Origin

provenance: supported. Targets: CHEBI:6570.

The retained MIBiG BGC0001317 version 3 producer is Lotus japonicus (NCBITaxon:34305), graded SOURCE_ASSERTION. The active locus remains CLUSTER_UNSTATED, with TERPENE class, questionable source quality and unknown completeness. MIBIG.BGC0001317.1 is the retained synthetic accession string rather than newly verified sequence evidence. No assay or occurrence row supplies the missing locus method or a demonstrated producer strain.

### Citations

evidence: supported. Targets: CHEBI:6570.

DOI:10.1016/j.phrs.2020.105373 is explicitly a MIBiG COMPOUND_BIOACTIVITY-level citation carried into the source assertion; it is not treated as fresh experimental evidence for Lotus japonicus production. LOTUS DOI strings and ChEBI origin PMIDs remain occurrence evidence. PubChem AID 1919462 is a BindingDB-deposited patent assay identifier, not two independent publications. Reference equivalence and publication independence have not been newly established.

### Activity

evidence: supported. Targets: CHEBI:6570.

The owner writes 25 LOTUS placements and explicitly notes 1027 further cited occurrences in the retained inventories. These written limits are preserved; the complete source inventory contains 1071 LOTUS matches and three ChEBI origin rows, with synonym, taxon-merge and literal-citation handling assessed separately from scientific independence. The three origin rows distinguish Breynia fruticosa root from Croton gratissimus stem and leaf. Old taxon IDs 13481, 130257 and 1475459 have exact saved forward routes to 2775048, 2576591 and 2839962; this is local cached authority, not a live taxonomy check. Two written ACTIVE observations share AID1919462 and the title Metabolic Measurements from US Patent US11660306: Treatment of Rett syndrome, with KI values 1.5 and 2.5 uM and retained target UniProtKB:P18031. Both measurements remain visible as DATABASE_ASSERTION; source title, activity call and target string do not independently prove a pharmacological mechanism, a specific binding experiment or assay identity. No separate molecular_targets or biosynthetic mechanism root is declared.

### Versioned classification applicability

consistency: supported. Targets: CHEBI:6570.

The versioned NPClassifier Terpenoids/Triterpenoids/Lupane triterpenoids and is_glycoside:false outputs are consistent with the locally observed C30 pentacyclic alcohol topology and the separately retained ChEBI definition. This is an applicability assessment of the saved representation, not new proof of biosynthesis or natural identity. The broad definition occurrences, producer claim and two assay rows are not used as classifier ground truth.

### Completion

completeness: unknown. Targets: CHEBI:6570.

The whole current owner/history and actual intake are read, including the maintained assay-exclusion and taxon-merge context ownership. Complete source coverage is jointly attributed across the disjoint readers; occurrence counts are not independent-experiment counts. No maintained reader is applicable to this owner. Fresh patent/target/primary verification, full QC and complete OAK coverage are unavailable; the evidence supports a partial qualified review without a confirmed corrective finding.

## Limits And Additional Notes

- All evidence is retained locally. No external publication, identifier, taxonomy, protein sequence or natural stereochemical assertion was refreshed under the absolute no-request instruction.
- Full QC and complete OAK authority coverage remain unavailable. Original gates, stored-form parsing and maintained-reader preservation establish only their stated scope.
- Exact empty joins are bounded by saved predicates/snapshots; shared loci, names, taxa or citations do not transfer identity, production, activity or mechanism.
- Two original undefined-stereo and two charge-rearrangement warnings remain global and unassigned. No additional molecular/YAML parse, source query or target invocation occurred during scientific authoring.
- No source record or native status/history is edited. Computed model concerns do not automatically establish a maintained-source defect.
- The whole selected owner was read, but scientific completion is partial because full QC, complete ontology authority coverage and external source verification were unavailable. No native status or history was changed.
- The branch uses cached base ce6a5498df5be51116bd5e0c119023ee62bb5464. Fresh origin/main verification and publication are deferred because the user prohibits all external requests.
- Support personally read all five complete raw owners/history, actual intakes and the disjoint source partition; exact prior companion carries and BGC/Native complementary readings remain attributed in the joint notes.
- Support personally read all ten saved forms: 312 atom and 338 bond rows, every scalar/ring/stereo/motif/map (a98425, da0f1d, d898a7, dc945f). The original correspondence limits are preserved; no new graph computation or molecular parse.
- ROOT operated activation/capture, inventory/composer, canonical intakes and the diagnostic. Native operated original gates and maintained reader under ROOT authorization; ROOT separately accepted results. Scientific authoring invoked none of these targets.
- Saved review coverage is distinct from the native SEEDED/REVIEWED curation state. Proposed actions are not performed edits.
